raw_response:
I’ve farmed here a long time, so I won’t make big changes this year. Cotton is still my main crop because I know it well and it brings cash, so I’ll keep the biggest share there. I won’t plant too much stevia even if it can sell for a better price, because it needs careful hand work and some people in my family are away working. The wheat already in the ground, I’ll manage it through harvest, then I’ll put summer maize right after on the same land. Water from the well is useful, but pumping costs money, so I’ll irrigate at the important times, not too many times. Fertilizer also costs a lot now, so I’ll use about what worked before, maybe a little on the safe side if the crop color looks weak. I mostly follow what I’ve seen on my own fields and what the capable neighbors nearby are doing.
